local data = {{"U1","2026-06-15",{{"09:00","12:00"}}},{"U1","2026-06-16",{{"13:00","17:00"}}},{"U1","2026-06-17",{{"09:00","11:00"}}},{"U1","2026-06-18",{{"09:00","09:30"}}},{"U1","2026-06-19",{}},{"U2","2026-06-15",{{"11:30","15:00"}}},{"U2","2026-06-16",{{"09:00","13:30"}}},{"U2","2026-06-17",{{"10:30","14:00"}}},{"U2","2026-06-18",{}},{"U2","2026-06-19",{}},{"U3","2026-06-15",{{"14:30","17:00"}}},{"U3","2026-06-16",{}},{"U3","2026-06-17",{{"09:00","10:00"}}},{"U3","2026-06-18",{}},{"U3","2026-06-19",{{"16:00","17:00"}}},{"U4","2026-06-15",{{"10:00","11:00"}}},{"U4","2026-06-16",{{"11:00","12:00"}}},{"U4","2026-06-17",{{"15:30","16:30"}}},{"U4","2026-06-18",{}},{"U4","2026-06-19",{}}}

-- Parse HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function toMins(s)
  local h, m = s:match("(%d+):(%d+)")
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local days = {"2026-06-15","2026-06-16","2026-06-17","2026-06-18","2026-06-19"}

-- For each day, collect all busy intervals
for _, d in ipairs(days) do
  local busy = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(data) do
    if entry[2] == d then
      for _, b in ipairs(entry[3]) do
        busy[#busy+1] = {s=toMins(b[1]), e=toMins(b[2])}
      end
    end
  end
  
  -- Sort busy intervals
  table.sort(busy, function(a,b) return a.s < b.s end)
  
  -- Merge overlapping
  local merged = {}
  for _, b in ipairs(busy) do
    if #merged == 0 or b.s > merged[#merged].e then
      merged[#merged+1] = b
    else
      merged[#merged].e = math.max(merged[#merged].e, b.e)
    end
  end
  
  -- Working hours: 09:00 (540) to 17:00 (1020)
  local workStart, workEnd = 540, 1020
  
  -- Find earliest free 60-min slot on 30-min boundary
  local found = nil
  -- candidate start times: 540, 570, 600, ... up to 960 (17:00 - 60 = 16:00)
  for t = workStart, workEnd - 60, 30 do
    local free = true
    for _, b in ipairs(merged) do
      if t < b.e and t + 60 > b.s then
        free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if free then
      found = {date=d, start=t, finish=t+60}
      break
    end
  end
  
  local function fmt(m)
    return string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(m/60), m%60)
  end
  
  if found then
    print(d .. ": FIRST FREE = " .. fmt(found.start) .. "-" .. fmt(found.finish))
  else
    print(d .. ": NO FREE SLOT")
  end
end

return "done"
